subject: note:ccc_intake_docstore_boundaries
title: CCC, Intake and Docstore are three isolated systems
summary: CCC is project-local CocoIndex Code only. Intake is the multifaceted CocoIndex filesystem workstation using Weaviate for advanced search, SurrealDB for relationships, and multiple OCR/STT/video/SLM tools and libraries. Docstore is CocoIndex plus SurrealDB for project documentation. Keep app identity, tracking state, worker locks, credentials and target ownership separate. Intake's human-agent workflow is find, group, compare, decide and move; index unique readable content before evidence selection, retain every duplicate occurrence and provenance, and distinguish corroborating copies. Docstore helper limits do not define Intake eligibility.
rationale: Owner explicitly confirmed the three-system scope and requested durable critical decision marking on 2026-09-12.
